commands.cmd: p=$(command -v repomix) && echo "resolves: $p -> $(readlink -f "$p")" && repomix --version && python3 -c "import json,glob,sys;c=sys.argv[1];print('stack',[x['version'] for x in json.load(open('manifests/stack.json'))['components'] if x['id']==c],'winner pins',sorted({w['pin'] for f in glob.glob('catalogs/landscape/*.json') for l in json.load(open(f)).get('layers',[]) for w in (l.get('winners') or []) if w.get('component_id')==c}))" repomix

d=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1; repomix --include "fixtures/before.py,fixtures/after.py,fixtures/example.sh" --style xml --parsable-style --compress --token-count-encoding o200k_base --output "$d/pack.xml" --quiet; rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then python3 -c "import sys,xml.etree.ElementTree as E;r=E.parse(sys.argv[1]).getroot();f={e.get('path'):(e.text or '') for e in r.iter('file')};src={p:open(p).read() for p in f};py=[p for p in f if p.endswith('.py')];sig=all(f[p].strip()=='def greeting(name)' for p in py);body=all('return' in src[p] and 'return' not in f[p] for p in py);sh=f.get('fixtures/example.sh','').strip()==src.get('fixtures/example.sh','').strip();print('XML parsed; packed files',len(f),sorted(f),'| each .py packed as signature def greeting(name):',sig,'| return bodies in sources, absent from pack:',body,'| example.sh kept verbatim:',sh,'| fixtures/records.json packed:','fixtures/records.json' in f);raise SystemExit(0 if sorted(f)==['fixtures/after.py','fixtures/before.py','fixtures/example.sh'] and py and sig and body and sh else 1)" "$d/pack.xml"; rc=$?; else echo "repomix exit $rc"; fi; rm -rf "$d"; exit $rc

claim: On host mac-coordinator-64gb-20260925 (macOS arm64, Apple M5 Pro, 18 cores, 64 GB unified memory), repomix 1.18.1 (the manifests/stack.json pin, resolved and version-checked by the first command) packed three explicitly included fixture files with the documented flags --style xml --parsable-style --compress --token-count-encoding o200k_base into a temporary output, which a Python check parsed as XML. Exactly fixtures/after.py, fixtures/before.py and fixtures/example.sh were packed; fixtures/records.json, in the same folder but not included, was not (asserted). --compress reduced each Python file to its def greeting(name) signature, dropping the return body that is present in the real source but absent from the packed text (asserted, an inexact rewrite this receipt records rather than hides). The non-Python fixture, example.sh, was kept byte-for-byte (after whitespace normalization) verbatim (asserted). The command exits 0.
limitations: The workload is this repository's own fixtures/ files (three small files), which docs/contributing-evidence.md Section 2 classes as local_integration, not native_proven: packing a real, larger source tree, other output styles (markdown/json/plain), --no-files metadata-only mode and the skill-generation surface were not exercised.

--compress uses Tree-sitter to keep only declarations for supported languages; this is a lossy, documented rewrite (the .py bodies), not a bug, and this receipt checks for it rather than assuming exact content preservation.
